name: Vanidicus
source:
You and your friends are brought to a strange place without any memories of how you got there. Will you discover why you were brought there, or will you awaken the sinister feelings lurking inside all of you and end up following the plan of the one who brought you there?

[from [url=https://hapcyon.itch.io/vanidicus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和你的朋友被带到一个陌生的地方，却没有任何关于如何到达那里的记忆。你会发现你被带到那里的原因，还是会唤醒潜伏在你们所有人内心的险恶感觉，并最终遵循带你到那里的人的计划？

[来自[url=https://hapcyon.itch.io/vanidicus]itch.io[/url]]
